ext:name: Workflow
ext:hint: Everything else below a homepage: any workflow or version whose homepage is stored deeper than one segment. The three views above name the depths a homepage of one segment produces, which is every homepage a deployment normally has; this one keeps the rest working rather than leaving them unrouted. Ordered last, so the named depths are the ones the breadcrumb trail finds first. It begins with :homepage rather than being a bare splat so that it does not match the console's root, which is what kept that root a crumb leading to the same listing as the homepage after it.
